## Contribution Rules
- All changes via feature branch + Pull Request against `main`
- No direct pushes to `main`
- No secrets, keys, or sensitive data
- No fabricated professional content or unauthorized "VERIFIED" claims
- Preserve CV, experience, education, contact, and design integrity
- Minimal changes: only governance, security, link integrity fixes
